services.name: Onsite Controlled Bolting
services.tagline: Precision torque, delivered in the field
services.description: Professional controlled bolting services with precision torque application for critical industrial applications and maintenance operations. Torqueing up to 700 bar / 69,427 Nm max, bolts 19-175mm; tensioning up to 1,500 bar / 5,406 kN max, bolts 16-150mm.

services.name: Pipeline Coldcutting & Bevelling
services.description: Precise pipeline cutting and bevelling services using advanced cold cutting technology.

services.name: Flange Facing
services.description: Expert flange facing services to ensure perfect sealing surfaces and optimal performance.

services.name: Nitrogen Purging Preservation Services
services.description: Nitrogen purging and preservation services to protect pipeline systems.

services.name: Retubing Services
services.description: Complete retubing solutions for heat exchangers and industrial equipment: tube removal (1/2"-4-1/2" OD, pulling force to 22 T), tube insertion/expansion (3/8"-2-1/2" OD), tube sheet prep, weld overlay (GTAW/FCAW/SAW), and tube plugging (up to 7,000 psi).

services.name: Hot Tapping & Line Stopping
services.description: Safe hot tapping and line stopping services for live pipeline modifications. Pipe dia 2"-84" (50-2100mm), pressure to 100 bar (1,450 psi), temp -20°C to 280°C, materials CS/SS/Duplex/HDPE. Compliant with ASME B31.3/4/8, API 1104 App B, API 2201.

companyPage.overviewText: Tritorc is a trusted authority in controlled bolting, on-site machining, and pipeline integrity solutions — delivering turnkey expertise to industrial teams across 11 countries.
overviewLines: Founded in 1989, with more than 35 years of experience.
Offices across India, the UAE, the USA, Algeria, Oman, Canada and Germany.
In-house manufacturing of bolting and machining tools since 2013.
Live pipelines hot-tapped with zero downtime.

events.title: ADIPEC 2026
events.intro: Meet TRITORC at ADIPEC 2026 – where precision engineering meets real-world energy challenges.
about: ADIPEC 2026 is one of the world's leading energy exhibitions and conferences, bringing the global oil, gas and energy industry together in Abu Dhabi.
TRITORC will be there to talk controlled bolting, on-site machining and pipeline integrity.
